page.overview:
Who is Braan?

Braan appears in Mortal Kombat: Deception as an NPC in the game's Konquest mode. He is a harmless Outworlder fisherman hailing from the small village of Sun Do in Outworld. His name is derived from one of the game's creators: Steve Beran.

A robed man carrying a dagger named Gohsk speaks with Shujinko and tells him that he wishes to do battle with another individual named Braan. He asks that Shujinko tell Braan of this, should he meet him.

When the player encounters Braan and tells him of this, he asks Shujinko not to say anything to Gohsk, paying him 500 ruby koins for his silence.Category:Minor Characters Category:Konquest Mode Characters Category:Outworld Characters Category:Non-Playable Characters Category:Male Characters Category:Mortal Kombat: Deception Characters Category:Mortal Kombat: Deception Konquest Characters Category:Characters
